meta.name: alert-management
meta.description: Inspect fired CCAM alerts and manage alert rules for token thresholds, event patterns, inactivity, and status duration. Use when acknowledging alerts, creating or editing a rule, checking cooldowns, or connecting alert rules to webhook targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接收并确认告警，按需求调整触发规则，把提醒送进指定通知渠道。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果工作中常常需要处理告警，想自己调整规则和通知方式。
copy.tagline_en: Acknowledge alerts, tune rules, send reminders to your channel.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often handle alerts at work and want to adjust rules and notifications yourself.

howto.what: Claude 能查看未确认的 CCAM 警报，并管理警报规则（列出、创建、修改、删除）。修改规则前会先显示规则详情，经你同意后才执行。
howto.when: 当你要求查看或确认 CCAM 警报、创建或编辑警报规则，或检查冷却时间等操作时触发。

say.text: 查看当前有哪些未确认的警报。
say.note: Claude 会运行命令查看未确认警报并列出。

say.text: 新建一个总 token 阈值规则，阈值设为 1,000,000。
say.note: Claude 会先显示规则配置并请求确认。

say.text: 删除 ID 为 12 的警报规则。
say.note: Claude 会显示规则信息并请求确认后删除。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can inspect fired CCAM alerts and manage alert rules: view unacknowledged alerts, list rules, and create, update, or delete them after your confirmation. It will show rule details before making changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to view or acknowledge CCAM alerts, create or edit alert rules, check cooldowns, or connect rules to webhook targets.

say_en.note: Claude will view and list them.

say_en.text: Create a token threshold rule with total_tokens set to 1,000,000.
say_en.note: Claude will show config and ask for confirmation.

say_en.text: Delete the alert rule with ID 12.
say_en.note: Claude will show details and confirm first.
